scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: ln -sfn "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/node_modules" node_modules && { test -f .dev.vars || cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.dev.vars" .dev.vars; } && pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false db:migrate:local

scripts.name: Typecheck
scripts.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:server && pnpm typecheck:client
